update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.28 - Multi-run continues after an auto-abandoned run
Fixed ----- - In a parent-farming multi-run session, an auto-abandoned run no longer stops the whole session. Auto-Abandon previously stopped the bot outright, so the first doomed run that got abandoned ended an overnight farm instead of starting a fresh one. When multi-run is enabled, the bot now gives up the current career in-game (menu -> Give Up -> confirm) and rolls straight into the next run. Single-run sessions and every other stop condition (skill-point check, mandatory-race, etc.) are unchanged, and if the give-up navigation can't complete it falls back to the previous stop behavior.
